summary: Isla Mujeres National Airport (ISJ) is a small island airport serving Isla Mujeres, a popular Caribbean destination off the eastern coast of Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula. The airport primarily handles domestic flights, connecting the island to mainland hubs such as Mexico City and Cancún. Its compact terminal and scenic island setting make it a convenient gateway for travelers heading to one of Mexico's most beloved beach escapes.
faqs:
Q: What airlines operate from Isla Mujeres National Airport?
A: The airport is mainly served by domestic Mexican carriers offering flights to and from Mexico City and other mainland destinations.

Q: How far is the airport from the island's main town?
A: The airport is located near the southern part of the island, a short drive from downtown Isla Mujeres.

Q: Does Isla Mujeres Airport have international flights?
A: No, the airport handles domestic flights only. International travelers typically fly into Cancún International Airport and take a ferry to the island.

Q: Are there car rental services at the airport?
A: Rental options are limited at this small airport; most visitors arrange transportation in advance or use taxis and golf carts on the island.
transport_tips: Taxis are readily available outside the terminal for short trips to nearby hotels and the ferry terminal. Since the island is small, most destinations are within a 15-minute drive. Golf cart rentals on the island are a popular and fun way to explore, though parking at the airport is minimal.
local_tip: If you're arriving in the afternoon, time your landing for sunset — the approach over the turquoise Caribbean waters offers one of the most scenic views of any airport landing in Mexico.
